propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket signatures omit parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref) already supported by the library and CLI, making them unreachable over MCP because FastMCP derives schemas from those signatures and drops undeclared payload keys.

The MCP adapter callable bodies independently forward only close_class for transition and assignee for claim, so even if signature fields are added, the forwarding layer must be updated to pass all parameters unchanged to the library.

The 2026-08-18 operator ruling rescinds the prior CLI/library-only force policy and establishes that force is allowed through all surfaces (library, CLI, MCP) with absent certified attestation as the audit signal.

MCP ref was selecting HEAD instead of the requested commit, and MCP caused_by was closing without the edge, while the library produced both correctly, confirming the adapter boundary as the root cause.

The repair adds library-compatible parameters to MCP signatures (transition: force, reason, caused_by, ref; claim: force), forwards all parameters unchanged to rebar.transition and rebar.claim, and updates tool prose to reflect the absent-attestation audit model.
